name: Where should I add storage if my bathroom has no room for another cabinet?

mainEntity.name: Where should I add storage if my bathroom has no room for another cabinet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Storage should be planned around the items you actually use, not just the available wall area. A layout may combine vanity drawers, a recessed medicine cabinet, a linen cabinet, shower niches, hooks, and towel storage while keeping the floor clear. Recessed storage requires wall-depth and framing review, while oversized cabinetry can reduce circulation. Make a list of toiletries, towels, cleaning products, hair tools, and accessible items before choosing cabinet dimensions. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate storage into the bathroom layout, design visualization, and material-selection process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with a storage inventory. Vanity drawers, a recessed medicine cabinet, shower niches, hooks, and a nearby linen cabinet can provide capacity without filling the floor. Check wall depth, framing, plumbing, electrical, moisture exposure, and door clearances before choosing recessed or built-in storage.
